concepts.name: 方案 1 · 原位讲解
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: one polished 16:9 pottery painting interface concept, 1672x941 style.
Input image is the EXACT approved layout A and is the edit target. Preserve its airy ivory/taupe dappled two-dimensional background, matte pale bisque jar with sea-green textured painted strokes and deep cobalt leaves, thin stone turntable, warm translucent frosted glass UI, neutral brown active buttons, thin white borders, refined Songti Chinese typography. This is an app embedded in a platform, NO brand, logo, header bar, browser chrome, furniture or room. All UI materials must stay consistent frosted glass. The original image's visual quality and calm atmosphere must not degrade.
Primary request: demonstrate automatic short educational guidance when a confusing option is selected. Keep the approved layout A recognizably intact: two slim size/amount sliders at far left; large central-left jar; one main RIGHT panel with stage heading "03 / 装饰", title "留下一层颜色", material tabs "彩绘" / "效果釉", four effect sample thumbnails labelled "流彩" "晶花" "铁斑" "开片", firing modes "氧化" "还原" "柴烧" with small 1240°/1280°/1320°, cooling "缓冷"/"快冷", primary "完成上色，入窑 →"; below vessel an icon dock for 画笔 / 擦除 / 转台 / 浸釉 / 淋釉 / 铺底 / 撤销 / 清空, two unobtrusive leaf/flower stamp icons; single-row color strip and bottom-right rotate/zoom. Bottom-left tiny progress 起点 · 塑形 · 装饰 · 烧成 · 成品. Preserve access to every control and existing common colors.
Choose "效果釉" active and "流彩" selected for this screen. Visibly mark 流彩 with a restrained brown outline and active under-label, other samples neutral. Keep "氧化" and "缓冷" active as in reference. The jar itself is still the BEFORE FIRING painted bisque, NOT already a full glossy finished piece.
Show ONE short selected-option explanation with useful visual demonstration, not a lecture. Exact explanatory Chinese "薄处透色，厚处聚色。" Pair this with two clearly contrasting curved ceramic surface samples labelled "薄釉" and "厚釉": thin glaze shows pale translucent clear sea-green with the bisque tone softly showing; thick layered glaze sample shows richer blue-green pooled color and slight downward flowing bands. These are AFTER FIRING sample textures, title "烧后小样". Avoid photorealistic room thumbnails, vague decorative images, video play buttons or an unlabelled green square.
No instructional arrows over the jar, no long paragraphs, no defensive disclaimers, no unknown extra modes, no static science essay, no oversized modal, no full-screen pop-up, no multiple tips open at once, no scroll bars, clipped text or tiny unreadable labels. All primary options fully visible at once in a landscape desktop screen. Show a plausible finished actual UI state, no design annotation, no concept labels, no side-by-side board. All Chinese text sharp and accurate.

Specific layout change for proposal 1: the selected effect sample row directly reveals one small educational strip WITHIN the same right main panel, immediately underneath the four sample thumbnails. This strip is integrated into the panel, not a separate card and not an extra floating overlay. About 95px high, tasteful thin separators, same glass background. Left half contains "流彩" in small medium-weight serif and one short sentence "薄处透色，厚处聚色。", followed by the small caption "烧后小样". Right half contains the two side-by-side curved ceramic texture chips, about55x45px each, labels 薄釉 and 厚釉, with a tiny unobtrusive arrow between them. All content aligned, no clutter.
To make real space: reduce stage heading slightly to48px and title to28px, compact the four effect thumbnails to about76px high, carefully tighten section gaps. Right main panel may extend down to84% screen height but must leave room for the original bottom-right camera control. Keep all firing and cooling options and the primary action below the explanation and fully visible. This is a smooth inline-expansion state: ONE concise explanation, logically adjacent to the chosen option, no separate left guidance card. Do not make every category a bordered card. The right panel must still feel graceful and spacious.
